newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds narrowly mixed in uncertain market.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds narrowly mixed in uncertain market.

text.p: Argentine bonds were narrowly mixed in thin trade late morning Friday, as the market eyed U.S. Treasuries for direction.
"The market is very quiet," said a trader, adding that there was uncertainty ahead of next week's U.S. refunding which could pressure prices again.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 fell 1/8 to 89-1/2, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 rose $0.08 to 125.33.

Another trader said that considering the market's gains had not been very big during the last couple of sessions on the back of the rise in U.S. Treasuries, there could be more losses in store if Treasuries soften on the refunding.
"It's important to keep an eye on the funding," he said.
